messages:
olivia: Heads-up: I'm kicking off a refresh of the Quickstart/onboarding page. Scope: single-file "hello world" apps (JS + Python), browser auth (PKCE), server auth (rotating API key example), tiny Docker/local dev flow, and a minimal GH Actions deploy. Opening a draft PR in a bit. cc @hugo @xia

hugo: Awesome. Can we make the examples truly copy-paste runnable? That means include exact install commands and env var names.

xia: Also please add a one-line curl example to fetch a token and a short note on token scopes for Dedicated customers.

olivia: Agreed on both. Plan: JS (vanilla, 20 lines), Python (FastAPI tiny example), curl token fetch, and Dockerfile + docker-compose for local static front-end.

hugo: For the JS browser auth snippet, default to PKCE and show the redirect handler as a 3-line snippet. Keep secrets out of client code.

xia: For server-side example, show rotation with a cron comment and link to ops guide. Add an env var example: REDWOOD_HOST, REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_KEY_ROTATE_INTERVAL.

olivia: Draft JS snippet I'll include (will format in PR):
```js
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
// PKCE start
await client.auth.login({ flow: 'pkce', redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/callback' });
// generate
const r = await client.generate('Hello from quickstart!');
console.log(r.text);
```

hugo: Nice. For the Python example use FastAPI + uvicorn so users can run `uvicorn app:app --reload`. Keep it <15 lines.

xia: Also add a small troubleshooting section: 401 => check API key scopes and host; CORS => update allowed origins in console; redirect mismatch => ensure redirect URI exactly matches.

olivia: Will do. I'm also adding a short Docker Compose to run a static server and set REDWOOD_HOST override for Dedicated testing. Optional, behind an accordion.

ci-bot: Preview build queued for PR #312 on branch docs/qs-refresh-312.

staging-bot: Staging site live at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/qs-refresh-312 (expires in 6 days).

hugo: Quick nit: the package import should use named export `Client` not default. Also bump example version to v0.11.

xia: I'll run the examples locally and post any fixes. If you need, I can add a tiny unit test in the docs repo that runs the demo build.

olivia: Thanks — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312. Opening as draft. Please add inline comments; I'll iterate.

hugo: Small UX note: include a note about "first deployment" that points to Dedicated vs Hosted differences (envs and host override).

xia: For Dedicated mention KMS + rotate tokens every 30 days and set REDWOOD_HOST to your control plane.

olivia: I'll add migration blurb and a Code block showing recommended env vars. Also adding short paragraph on PKCE UX tradeoffs.

hugo: One more ask: add a one-liner to the top of the page that says "Estimated read time: 4 minutes" — helps impatient devs. :)

olivia: Ha, will do. ETA to move PR out of draft: tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :rocket:
